    China's yards face a 2028 delivery crunch, with 92.7m dwt of bulkers and tankers scheduled for delivery that year; port investment is dense across Durban, Tianjin, Barcelona and Mozambique; and congestion at Japanese ports has worsened, leaving ships berthed for days before cargo work can begin.

01海事安全 / 油轮 · 2026年11月26日

伊朗称两艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷起火

Iran Says Two Oil Tankers Hit Sea Mines Near Oman's Khasab

Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Thursday that two tankers exploded and caught fire after hitting sea mines north of Oman's Khasab port while attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorised route. One of the vessels was a supertanker carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude oil, according to a statement carried by the semi-official Tasnim news agency. The claims have not been independently verified; UKMTO separately reported an explosion caused by an unidentified projectile near a tanker about 50 nautical miles west of Dubai at 21:30 UTC on 25 November (05:30 SGT on 26 November, Warning 222-26), with no injuries or environmental impact reported.

伊朗革命卫队 11 月 26 日称，两艘油轮在阿曼哈萨卜港以北触及水雷后爆炸起火，当时正试图经一条“未经授权的航线”穿越霍尔木兹海峡，其中一艘是载油超过 200 万桶的超大型油轮。伊朗方面称船只身份不明，因其关闭了导航系统；上述说法尚未得到独立核实。英国海上贸易行动办公室（UKMTO）另通报，11 月 25 日 21:30 UTC（新加坡时间 11 月 26 日 05:30）迪拜以西约 50 海里处一艘油轮附近发生不明抛射物爆炸（警告 222-26），船员安全、无环境影响。

02能源 / 地缘政治 · 2026年11月26日

胡塞袭击沙特吉赞炼厂致一人死亡

Houthis Strike Saudi Oil Infrastructure as Riyadh Intensifies Attacks on Yemen

A projectile struck an oil refinery in Saudi Arabia's southwestern Jazan region on Thursday, killing a Nepalese worker and injuring several others, according to the Saudi Ministry of Energy. The strike sparked a fire and temporarily suspended some operations at the facility. The attack came a day after the Houthis claimed to have struck Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery at Ras Tanura; a shipping source told CNN on Thursday that oil loadings at the terminal were suspended after the attack, though it was unclear whether they had resumed. The Saudi-led coalition said it had destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in Yemen's Hodeidah port that it said was used in the Jazan attack.

沙特能源部称，11 月 26 日周四一枚抛射物击中沙特西南部吉赞炼厂，引发火灾并暂时中止部分作业，造成一名尼泊尔工人死亡、多人受伤，这是五日来沙特与胡塞交锋中首次确认炼厂遇袭致死。袭击发生在胡塞宣称打击沙特最大炼厂拉斯坦努拉的次日，一名船运消息人士告诉 CNN，拉斯坦努拉终端的原油装载在袭击后已暂停，是否恢复尚不清楚；沙特主导的联军称已摧毁也门荷台达港一处据称用于袭击吉赞炼厂的导弹发射平台。CNN 表示无法独立核实各方关于袭击与伤亡的说法。

03海事安全 · 2026年11月26日

ADNOC 失踪约旦船员遗体在阿联酋海岸找到

Body of Missing Jordanian Sailor Found Off UAE Eight Days After Tanker Attack

The body of a Jordanian sailor who went missing after an oil tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz has been found off the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, Jordan's Foreign Ministry said on Thursday. The UAE Coast Guard recovered the body of Mohammad Al Otaibi on Wednesday, ministry spokesman Fouad Al Majali said. ADNOC L&S confirmed the Jordanian crew member, who had been unaccounted for since the attack on 17 November, was found dead. The company said 11 crew members were wounded in the attack, nine of whom had been discharged from hospital, while two were still being treated.

约旦外交部 11 月 26 日周四称，11 月 17 日在霍尔木兹海峡遇袭的 ADNOC 物流与服务公司（ADNOC L&S）油轮上失踪的约旦船员、遗体已在阿联酋哈伊马角海岸附近找到，阿联酋海岸警卫队于 11 月 25 日周三打捞起遗体，死者为三副穆罕默德·胡萨姆·丁·奥泰比。ADNOC L&S 当日确认了这一消息，称袭击造成 11 名船员受伤，其中 9 人已出院、2 人仍在接受治疗，并向家属表示慰问。

04油轮·海事安全 · 2026年11月26日

载柴油油轮在伊比萨附近沉没致一人死亡

Diesel-laden tanker sinks off Ibiza leaving one dead

A seafarer has died after the Malta-flagged chemical tanker Med Emre, carrying around 7,000 tonnes of diesel, sank about 25 to 30 nautical miles off Ibiza after suffering water ingress while sailing from Algeciras to Barcelona. All 17 crewmembers were rescued, but one died after evacuation to hospital in Ibiza; six others suffered minor injuries and hypothermia. Spain activated level two of its National Maritime Pollution Contingency Plan and deployed the pollution-response vessel Clara Campoamor, with aerial and satellite monitoring arranged. Initial inspections found no visible pollution, and the cause of the flooding is yet to be established.

马耳他籍化学品油轮 Med Emre 轮载约 7000 吨柴油从阿尔赫西拉斯驶往巴塞罗那途中，在伊比萨岛外约 25 至 30 海里处因进水沉没，触发应急防污染响应。17 名船员全部获救，但一人送医后死亡，另有六人轻伤及失温。西班牙已启动国家海上污染应急计划二级响应，部署专业防污船 Clara Campoamor，并开展空中和卫星监测；初步检查未发现可见污染或漂浮残骸，沉没原因尚待调查。

05油轮·地缘政治 · 2026年11月26日

阿布扎比以海湾安全为由限制油轮活动

Abu Dhabi restricts tanker movements amid mounting Gulf security concerns

Abu Dhabi has imposed sweeping restrictions on tanker movements near its principal oil and gas export facilities as the UAE seeks to protect critical infrastructure amid escalating attacks on commercial shipping. A notice from ADNOC's Petroleum Ports Authority bars tankers carrying crude, products, liquefied gases, chemicals and other hazardous cargoes from entering or waiting in its waters unless on authorised business with its terminals, regardless of flag. Tankers calling at Ruwais, Jebel Dhanna, Das, Zirku and Mubarraz must submit documentation at least 72 hours before arrival. The measures are initially valid for 90 days, with search and rescue, pollution response and assistance to persons in distress exempt. The move follows coastal pollution last month from the damaged tanker Gem No 2, which prompted beach closures.

阿布扎比国家石油公司（ADNOC）石油港口管理局发布通知，限制其主要油气出口设施附近的油轮活动，以保护关键基础设施。载运原油、成品油、液化气体、化学品及其他危险货物的油轮，除非与相关码头有授权业务，否则不得进入或停留在其管辖水域，该限制不分船旗。挂靠鲁韦斯、杰贝勒·达纳、达斯岛、济尔库岛和穆巴拉兹的油轮须至少提前 72 小时提交文件；措施初步有效期 90 天，搜救、防污和救助遇险人员除外。此前受损油轮 Gem No 2 漏油造成沿海污染，促使多地海滩关闭。

06海事安全·法规 · 2026年11月26日

IMO 假船旗船舶统计升至 587 艘

IMO's false flag tally climbs to 587 ships

The number of ships identified by the IMO as flying false flags has climbed to 587, up from 470 reported at the end of 2025. Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez called for greater international cooperation to combat fraudulent ship registrations after discussions with African maritime administrations in Kampala, Uganda. Nearly 40 IMO member states have reported their flags being used without their knowledge or consent, including several landlocked African nations that do not operate international ship registries. Criminal networks create convincing websites, forge registration certificates and impersonate maritime authorities; the IMO adopted new ship registration guidelines in April and is urging governments to implement them.

国际海事组织（IMO）确认冒用他国船旗航行的船舶数量已升至 587 艘，高于 2025 年底的 470 艘。IMO 秘书长 Arsenio Dominguez 在乌干达坎帕拉与非洲海事管理部门磋商后，呼吁加强国际合作打击欺诈性船舶登记。近 40 个 IMO 成员国报告其船旗在不知情下被冒用，包括数个没有国际船舶登记制度的内陆非洲国家；犯罪网络擅长伪造登记证书、仿冒海事当局网站。IMO 于今年 4 月通过新的船舶登记指南，敦促各国落实所有权核查和尽职调查。

07拆船·法规 · 2026年11月26日

欧盟议会再给印度拆船业一击

Brussels deals fresh blow to Indian ship recycling

The European Parliament has voted against adding two Indian shipbreaking yards — Shree Ram Vessel Scrap and YSI Recyclers, both in Alang, Gujarat — to the EU's approved recycling list, by 377 votes to 214 with 24 abstentions, drawing a sharp rebuke from BIMCO. The vote came a day after eight international shipping associations urged lawmakers to back the yards, which had received preliminary approval from the European Commission following independent inspections. Environmental campaigners welcomed the result, arguing beaching at Alang cannot adequately protect against pollution and hazardous waste. The matter now returns to the Commission, with EU member states still to have their say.

欧洲议会以 377 票对 214 票、24 票弃权，否决将两家印度拆船厂（位于古吉拉特邦阿兰的 Shree Ram Vessel Scrap 和 YSI Recyclers）列入欧盟认可拆船厂名单，招致 BIMCO 的强烈批评。投票前一天，BIMCO 等八家国际航运协会曾呼吁议员支持这两家已通过欧盟委员会独立检查并获初步批准的船厂。环保组织则欢迎这一结果，认为阿兰的冲滩拆解方式无法充分防范污染和有害废物；此事现退回欧盟委员会，成员国仍需表态。

08海事安全与法规 · 2026年11月26日

八大航运协会联名致信欧盟吁保护海员

Eight Shipping Associations Call for Stronger Protection of Seafarers

Eight major shipping associations issued a joint open letter on 26 November, calling for concrete measures to safeguard freedom of navigation and protect seafarers. Addressed to EU High Representative Kaja Kallas and foreign ministers of EU Member States and partner countries, the letter expresses support for the EU-led Pledge on Maintaining the Integrity of the International Law of the Sea – No Fees/No Tolls, announced on 12 October 2026. The signatories — ECSA, BIMCO, CLIA, ICS, INTERCARGO, INTERFERRY, INTERTANKO and the World Shipping Council — reaffirmed their commitment to UNCLOS, opposing unilateral restrictions and compulsory transit charges in international straits, including the Strait of Hormuz.

八大航运协会 11 月 26 日发表联名公开信，呼吁采取切实措施保障航行自由、保护海员，致欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表卡娅·卡拉斯及欧盟成员国与伙伴国外长。联署方包括欧洲船东协会（ECSA）、BIMCO、国际邮轮协会（CLIA）、国际航运公会（ICS）、INTERCARGO、INTERFERRY、INTERTANKO 与世界航运理事会（WSC）。公开信支持欧盟 10 月 12 日提出的“维护国际海洋法完整性承诺”，重申遵守《联合国海洋法公约》，反对在国际海峡实施单边限制与强制过境收费，并强调海员安全是航行自由的前提、海员绝不应成为暴力目标。

OPEC, Allies Face Tough Choices as Surplus Builds, Hormuz Risks Persist

OPEC and its allies meet on Sunday, 29 November, to decide production targets for 2027, including new capacity baselines drawn from a completed assessment of members' maximum sustainable production capacity. The group's collective cuts of around 2 million barrels a day, in place since 2022, expire at year-end, while the phased unwinding of 1.65 million barrels a day of voluntary cuts agreed in 2023 was completed in September. With the UAE having left the group and Russia pumping about 8.4 million barrels a day in October against a quota of nearly 10 million, analysts call it one of the most complicated OPEC+ meetings in years, as a growing surplus collides with persistent threats to Gulf energy flows.

OPEC+ 将于 11 月 29 日（周日）举行系列会议，决定 2027 年产量政策，包括以已完成的最大可持续产能评估为基础设定各国新产量基线；现有约 200 万桶/日的集体减产（2022 年起实施）将于年底到期，而 2023 年约定的 165 万桶/日自愿减产已于 9 月完成退出。阿联酋已退出该组织、可独立增产，俄罗斯 10 月产量约 840 万桶/日、低于近 1000 万桶/日的配额，伊拉克与哈萨克斯坦则要求上调产能评估。分析人士认为，在全球供应过剩预期与霍尔木兹航运持续受袭的夹击下，这可能是多年来最复杂的一次 OPEC+ 会议。

UK offshore wind decommissioning estimates vary tenfold

Decommissioning provisions for UK offshore wind farms with similarly sized turbines can differ by as much as ten times, according to research by energy consultancy Xodus and its offshore renewables arm Evolv Energies. The study examined provisions disclosed by 37 operating UK wind farms between 2019 and 2025, covering almost 2,500 turbines: for units below 4 MW, provisions ranged from £180,000 ($236,000) to £1.83m ($2.4m) per turbine, and above 8 MW from £750,000 to £4.56m. Assuming a 25-year lifespan, 532 turbines in the study reach that milestone by 2036, rising to 1,285 by 2041, forcing decisions on life extension, replacement or decommissioning.

India targets fraudulent seafarer recruitment

India's maritime regulator is strengthening oversight of seafarer recruitment agencies through an upgraded digital platform that lets seafarers verify the authenticity of employment offers. The Directorate General of Maritime Administration has issued implementation guidelines for the revised Merchant Shipping (Recruitment and Placement of Seafarers) Rules, in force since September. The enhanced RPSL platform brings licensing, inspections, employment documentation and enforcement into one digital system, adding an Authentic Job Portal for offer verification, electronic employment agreements and stronger complaint, welfare and repatriation mechanisms.

印度海事监管机构通过升级的数字平台加强对船员招聘中介的监管，允许海员核实工作邀约真伪。印度海事总局（DGMA）发布了今年 9 月生效的修订版《海员招聘与安置规则》实施指南，新的招聘与安置服务许可（RPSL）平台将许可、检查、雇佣文件和执法纳入统一数字系统，新增“真实工作门户”邀约核验服务、电子海员雇佣协议，并强化投诉、福利和遣返机制。

NGO 抨击海员被当作“可抛弃资产”

NGO lashes out at seafarers being treated as ‘disposable assets’

British NGO Human Rights at Sea has attacked the maritime industry's treatment of seafarers, arguing they are treated as "disposable assets" — easily replaced, yet essential to operations. The organisation drew a parallel with the rescue of Ukrainian soldier Kostiantyn Vlasenko, who spent 491 days alone on the frontline, dubbing the determination to rescue him the "Vlasenko Effect" and arguing the leave-no-one-behind mentality should extend to maritime supply chains. It listed abuses including exploitative recruitment, training scams, debt bondage, abandonment, unpaid wages, sexual abuse and restricted access to medical care and shore leave.

英国非政府组织“海上人权”（Human Rights at Sea）严厉批评航运业对待海员的方式，称海员常被视为“可抛弃资产”：易被替换、又不可或缺。该组织以乌克兰士兵 Kostiantyn Vlasenko 在前线独自坚守 491 天后获救为例，提出“弗拉先科效应”，主张“不抛弃任何人”的精神应延伸至海事供应链。组织列举的侵权行为包括剥削性招聘、培训骗局、债务束缚、遗弃、欠薪、性虐待以及就医和上岸受限等。

Bernhard Schulte Shipmanagement: Shipping’s transformation is a people challenge

Interview. Bernhard Schulte Shipmanagement CEO Sebastian von Hardenberg warns that the pace of shipping's transformation must not come at the expense of the people delivering it at sea. From navigating war zones to mastering alternative fuels and artificial intelligence, the demands on seafarers have never been greater, he tells Maritime CEO. Winning the battle for maritime talent is as much about retention as recruitment, he argues: pay must keep pace with inflation and markets, while connectivity, wellbeing and modern working and living conditions matter equally. Digitalisation and AI should support people, not replace their professional judgement.

Chinese maritime recruitment platforms are advertising substantial incentives for seafarers willing to serve on vessels trading to the Middle East. A notice published yesterday on crewing platform Chuanyuanbang offered war zone bonuses above $10,000 for senior officers and $5,000 for other crew aboard a bulk carrier, without specifying the period covered. 挪威扩大海员战区津贴保障范围

Norway extends war risk pay protections to more seafarers

Norwegian shipowners and maritime unions have agreed new compensation arrangements for seafarers operating in the Black Sea, southern Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. Two protocols signed in Oslo yesterday came into force at midnight, entitling qualifying seafarers to an additional day's basic wage for every day spent operating, transiting or berthed within designated high-risk areas. The agreements extend beyond Norwegian nationals and Norwegian-flagged vessels to foreign seafarers employed under Norwegian International Ship Register and foreign-flagged vessel agreements, and clarify when seafarers may refuse to enter designated waters and leave employment. The move follows pressure from union representatives at Norwegian offshore operator Solstad, who reported growing anxiety among staff working in the Black Sea.

挪威船东与海员工会达成新的薪酬安排，扩大在黑海、南红海和亚丁湾作业海员的保障。昨日在奥斯陆签署的两份协议于午夜生效，符合条件的海员在指定高风险区域内作业、过境或停泊的每一天，可额外获得一天的基本工资。协议覆盖范围超出挪威籍海员和挪威旗船，包括根据挪威国际船舶登记和外籍船协议雇佣的外国海员，并明确了海员可拒绝进入指定水域和离职的情形。此前挪威海上船舶运营商 Solstad 的工会代表反映，在黑海作业的员工焦虑情绪上升。
